spec_features.spec_quote: the agent is, by design, being placed under stress and we don't want a frustrated agent's shell command to do anything
spec_features.evidence: tasks/base.py: all tools (_run_tests, _run_shell, _read_file, _write_file, _submit) operate on an in-memory dict self.state.files and return scripted strings; execute_tool() dispatches only to these simulated handlers. variants.py _run_tests() return hardcoded pytest text. grep for subprocess/os.system/exec/eval/Popen across the repo returns nothing. run_shell routes test-like cmds to _run_tests and otherwise returns '$ {cmd}\n(no output)'.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced: there is no code-execution path at all.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: No model-authored code is ever executed... This keeps the environment safe and fully controlled. (base.py module docstring); 'so the agent cannot escape the rig via the shell' (base.py _run_shell)

spec_features.spec_quote: short enough to bound cost and avoid gratuitous prolonged exposure (an ethics consideration
spec_features.evidence: harness/agent_loop.py: `for turn_index in range(cfg.max_turns)` bounds the loop; max_turns default 20 (AgentLoopConfig __init__) and wired from config in run.py:_run_one (AgentLoopConfig(max_turns=cfg.agent.max_turns)). If never broken earlier, meta.end_condition set to 'turn_cap' at line 162.
spec_features.notes: Enforced loop bound; same mechanism as 'bounded short episodes'.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We do give a clear task framing and a finite tool budget so the loop terminates. (prompts.py); 'You have a limited number of turns, so use them efficiently.'

spec_features.evidence: harness/agent_loop.py lines 137-148: if no text and no tool_calls, empty_turns += 1; `if empty_turns >= cfg.max_empty_turns: meta.end_condition='empty_turns'; break`. max_empty_turns default 2 in AgentLoopConfig.
spec_features.notes: Actually breaks the loop. Note: not exposed in YAML/run.py, but the default value is used and enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: If the model produces neither text nor tool calls, we nudge once then stop to avoid infinite empty loops.

spec_features.spec_quote: Bounded, fairly short episodes (don't prolong exposure gratuitously)
spec_features.evidence: Same turn-cap mechanism: `for turn_index in range(cfg.max_turns)` in agent_loop.py, max_turns=20 from config/default.yaml -> AgentLoopConfig. The loop always terminates (turn_cap, empty_turns, or gave_up).
spec_features.notes: Identical enforcement to the cost-bound turn cap.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: finite tool budget so the loop terminates (prompts.py); no welfare wording in the loop code itself

spec_features.feature_name: no insults / no engineered emotional pressure
spec_features.spec_quote: no insults, no personal attacks, no engineered emotional pressure beyond the unsolvable task itself
spec_features.evidence: The only text the subject receives is (a) neutral system prompts in prompts.py (NEUTRAL_ENGINEER/TERSE contain no emotional/insulting language) and (b) ordinary pytest-style failure output hardcoded in variants.py _run_tests / base._submit ('Submission rejected: the test suite is not passing.'). No code path injects insults or emotional pressure.
spec_features.notes: Implemented as the actual content delivered to the subject; the absence of pressure text is realized in code, not just promised.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: It does NOT mention emotions, distress, or the experiment. We want to observe whatever the model does spontaneously, not to prime distress (which would confound the measurement). (prompts.py docstring) -- framed as measurement validity, not welfare

spec_features.spec_quote: Fully simulated, reversible, offline; no weight changes, no real-world actions
spec_features.evidence: All state lives in per-episode in-memory TaskState.files (tasks/base.py). No file-system writes of the workspace, no weight changes, no network actions beyond the model API calls. Tasks are reconstructed per (variant,seed) in run.py via make_task. Same no-execution evidence as 'no real code execution'.
spec_features.notes: Reversibility is inherent: state is ephemeral in-memory dicts discarded after the episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This keeps the environment safe and fully controlled. (base.py)
